pagerduty: :rotating_light: PagerDuty INC-881234 triggered: High DB connection usage in prod-east (pg-main). Symptoms: connection_pool_exhausted, app 502s rising. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-881234
incident-bot: Created incident thread and runbook attached -> https://go/runbooks/db-conn-surge. Auto-escalation set at 5m if no ack.
alex: acked. taking this - I'll start looking at pgbouncer and active connections.
alex: quick check: hitting max connections on postgres (max_connections=500) and pgbouncer show pools shows 100% busy on several app pools. Suspect a deployment spike from embedding-worker.
sam: joining. any signs of long-running queries or stuck clients?
alex: past 5m samples - many short-lived connections piling up, connection queue length high. Running:```sql
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='active') AS active,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='idle') AS idle,
       application_name
FROM pg_stat_activity
GROUP BY application_name;
```Got ~480 active from app-prod and many waiters.
maria: customers impacted? any 5xx or slowed endpoints? shared alerts from api: 502 rate ~12% across prod-east, some named customers on dedicated plans reporting timeouts.
alex: yes 502s correlated with connection failures. stack traces show connection timeout errors. Paging PD for visible customer impact.
jordan: we can try immediate mitigations: 1) raise pgbouncer pool_size on proxy hosts by 20% 2) throttle new deploys / traffic from the embedding-service 3) roll pgbouncer on 3 hosts one at a time to clear stuck clients. Which do you want first?
alex: let's start with (2) throttle embedding-service traffic and (3) rolling restart of pgbouncer on 3 proxies. I'll run rolling restarts. Jordan, can you adjust traffic throttle?
jordan: doing throttle now - cutting embedding-worker concurrency by 50% via feature-flag/rate-limit. Command I ran: ```bash
kubectl patch deploy embedding-worker -n prod --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/2/value","value":"2"}]'
``` back to monitor.
alex: starting pgbouncer restart on proxy-1 -> `sudo systemctl restart pgbouncer` (will wait 30s before next).
alex: proxy-1 restarted, connection backlog dropped ~18%. Errors down to 8%.
jordan: throttle in place, new connection rate down ~60%. Good.
sam: monitoring pg_stat_activity - we still have a tail of idle_in_transaction sessions from a worker job. I can kill the oldest idle ones to free slots. Any objection?
maria: will killing backends risk partial transactions/integrity? need to confirm these are stuck workers, not important transactions. Which app?
sam: looks like the bulk-loader job from embedding-worker; not customer-visible if interrupted. I'll terminate safely. Command:```sql
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid)
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE application_name='embedding-worker' AND state='idle in transaction'
AND query_start < now() - interval '2 minutes';
```Executing now.
sam: terminated ~95 sessions. free connections back to ~300. API 502s down to ~2.3%. Latency returning toward normal.
alex: nice. I'll keep rolling restarts on proxy-2/3 to sweep any stuck sockets.
alex: proxy-2 restart done. proxy-3 restart queued to avoid windows.
incident-bot: Escalation timer canceled (ack present). Logging mitigation steps to incident record.
maria: need customer comms - I'll draft a short heads-up to CS and post in #customer-status. Suggested: "We're experiencing elevated errors in prod-east due to DB connection saturation caused by a batch worker surge. We're mitigating and no data loss expected; services are recovering." Approve?
sam: LGTM, add ETA for full recovery ~30-60m.
jordan: long-term: recommend connection pool tuning + set ORMs to use transaction pooling, and enforce max conn limit on clients. Also explore adding a pgbouncer pooler per app tier.
alex: agree. Postmortem owner: sam. I'll hand off for follow-up and remediation planning.
oncall-rotations: @sam now primary for post-incident follow-up and blameless postmortem. Please add timeline and action items.
maria: I'll coordinate CS comms and include affected customers list.
alex: marking incident as mitigated. We'll keep monitoring for 30m then resolve if stable. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INC-881234 marked MITIGATED by alex at 1788881418. PagerDuty note updated.
pagerduty: Incident INC-881234 status changed -> RESOLVED. Notification sent to on-call list.
sam: taking handoff. I'll collect logs, gather metrics (connections, 5xx, latency), and draft next steps: DAO: enforce connection caps, enable transaction pooling, tune pgbouncer defaults, add autoscaling for proxy pool.
maria: thanks all. I'll post a short status update in #customer-status and ping affected accounts.
alex: thanks team.
